strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Pūmanawa hoko ā-wēna mō ngā māngai hoko
strings.tierB.home.description: Pūmanawa mō ngā kaitohatoha: nama me ngā rihīti mai i te waea a te māngai, taonga wēna, kohinga moni, ara, toronga. Ka mahi tuimotu, ka tukutahi ā muri.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Whakahaerehia ō māngai hoko, mai i te toronga tuatahi ki te kohinga moni whakamutunga
strings.tierB.home.definition: He pūhara kapua (cloud) a FieldSales mō ngā pakihi tohatoha me ngā pakihi hoko rarahi (wholesale) e whai māngai hoko haereere ana, tae atu ki te hoko ā-wēna (van sales). Ka tuku, ka tā hoki ngā māngai i ngā nama me ngā rihīti mai i ō rātou waea, ka aroturuki i ngā taonga o te wēna, ka tuhi i ngā toronga, ā, ka kite ngā kaiwhakahaere i ngā hoko, i ngā kohinga moni me ngā toenga nama a ngā kiritaki i te wā tonu e puta ana.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Nama mai i te waea a te māngai
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Ka tuku te māngai i te nama i te kuaha o te kiritaki, ka tā ki te pūtā wera Bluetooth i mua i tana wehenga atu i te toa.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Kohinga moni me ngā toenga nama
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Ka whiwhi ia utunga i tētahi rihīti whai tau, e hono ana ki ngā nama e utua ana e ia, ā, ka whakahōu tonu te toenga me te tauākī kaute a te kiritaki.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Kaitiakitanga o ngā taonga o te wēna
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Ka aroturukihia ngā taonga o ia wēna, tētahi ki tētahi: kua utaina, kua hokona, kua whakahokia, e toe ana; nō reira ka kitea he hapa i taua rā tonu.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Ngā ara me ngā toronga
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Ka tuhia ngā toronga me te tauwāhi, te wā me ngā whakaahua, ā, ka tuhia te ara o ia māngai ki te mahere mā te kaiwhakahaere.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Ka mahi tuimotu
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Ka hoko atu tonu ngā māngai ahakoa kāore he hononga. Ka tatari ngā tuhinga ki te waea, ā, ka tukutahi aunoa, kāore he tāruarua, ina hoki mai te hononga.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Papatohu tukutuku mō ngā kaiwhakahaere
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Ko ngā hoko, ngā kohinga moni, ngā whakahokinga, ngā taonga me te mahi a ia māngai kei te wāhi kotahi, me ngā tūranga me ngā mana uru mō ia kaiwhakamahi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Kōrero mai mō tō momo hoko
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Tonoa he tātai utu, whakaritea rānei he hui. Ka tirohia e mātou ō māngai, ō ara, ō hua me ō hiahia mō ngā nama.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Whakaritea tō pakihi
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Tāpiritia ngā hua, ngā utu, ngā kiritaki me ngā māngai, ā, tautuhia te momo moni me te pāpātanga tāke o tō whenua i ngā tautuhinga.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Tukuna ngā māngai ki ngā huarahi
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Ka whakauru ngā māngai i te taupānga ki ā rātou waea Android, iPhone rānei, ka uta i ō rātou wēna, ā, ka tīmata ki te hoko atu, ki te tā, ki te kohi moni.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Whāia te rā i a ia e haere ana
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Ka whakaatu te papatohu tukutuku i ngā hoko, i ngā kohinga moni, i ngā taonga wēna me ngā toronga, i te wā e haere tonu ana ngā māngai i ngā huarahi.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: He pūhara kapua a FieldSales hei whakahaere i ngā māngai hoko haereere i roto i ngā pakihi tohatoha me ngā pakihi hoko rarahi. Ka hāngai ki te hoko ā-wēna (van sales), te hoko ā-huarahi (route sales), te tango ota i mua (pre-sales) me te tuku tika ki te toa (DSD). Ka tuku nama, ka tā, ka kohi moni, ka tuhi toronga ngā māngai mai i ō rātou waea, ā, ka whai ngā kaiwhakahaere i ngā hoko, i ngā kohinga moni, i ngā taonga wēna me ngā toenga nama a ngā kiritaki mā te papatohu tukutuku.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Āe. Ka mahi tonu te taupānga a te māngai ahakoa kāore he ipurangi: ka tuku, ka tā ngā māngai i ngā nama me ngā rihīti, ka tuhi toronga, ka tāpiri kiritaki hou, ā, ka tukutahi aunoa ngā mea katoa, kāore he tāruarua, ina hoki mai te hononga. Kotahi te okotahi i Hauti Arāpia: ko ngā kamupene kua whakahohe i te tūhononga nama hiko me whai hononga i te wā e tukuna ana he nama, he whakahokinga rānei.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: Ko ēhea whenua e tautokona ana e FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: Ka tuku ratonga a FieldSales ki ngā pakihi tohatoha o ia whenua, tae atu ki Aotearoa. Ka tautuhi ia kamupene i tōna ake momo moni me te pāpātanga tāke i ōna tautuhinga, ā, ka whakamahia ēnei e ngā nama, e ngā rihīti me ngā pūrongo. Kei Riyadh, Hauti Arāpia te tari matua o FieldSales, ā, ka mahia te whakatū mā te ipurangi: mā ngā hui, mā WhatsApp, mā te tautoko mamao.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Ka hono a FieldSales ki ngā pūnaha nama hiko a te kāwanatanga?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Ka tautoko mātou i te tūhononga Wāhanga 2 ki te pūhara Fatoora a ZATCA. E pā ana tēnei ki ngā kamupene i Hauti Arāpia. I ētahi atu whenua, tae atu ki Aotearoa, ka tuku a FieldSales i ngā nama me tō momo moni me tō pāpātanga tāke, ā, ka wātea te hononga ki tētahi pūnaha nama hiko ā-motu mēnā ka tonoa, i muri i tā mātou arotake tahi me koe i ngā whakaritenga o taua whenua. Kāore mātou e kī taurangi ka hāngai ki aua whakaritenga i waho o Hauti Arāpia.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: He aha ngā reo o te taupānga FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Kei ēnei reo anake te atanga o te taupānga FieldSales: Ārapi, Ingarihi, Wīwī, Tākei me Hainamana. Kāore e wātea ana i te reo Māori. Ka taea e ngā māngai me ngā kaiwhakahaere te huri i te reo o te atanga, ā, ka taea e ngā nama kua tāia te whai reo tuarua i te taha o te reo matua. Ko ngā whārangi pae tukutuku i ētahi atu reo, pērā i tēnei whārangi reo Māori, he whakamāoritanga hei whakamōhio mō te hua.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Me pēhea taku tīmata ki a FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Tonoa he tātai utu, whakaritea he hui, tuhi mai rānei mā WhatsApp. Ka ako mātou me pēhea te mahi a ō māngai, kātahi ka āwhina i a koe ki te whakarite i ngā hua, ngā utu, ngā kiritaki me ngā māngai. Ka whakauru ngā māngai i te taupānga ki Android, ki iPhone rānei, ā, ka whakamahi ngā kaiwhakahaere i te papatohu tukutuku mai i tētahi pūtirotiro noa. Ko ngā waea atamai anake ngā taputapu e hiahiatia ana.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Kei ēnei reo anake te atanga o te taupānga FieldSales: Ārapi, Ingarihi, Wīwī, Tākei me Hainamana; kāore i te reo Māori. Ko ngā whārangi i ētahi atu reo hei whakamōhio anake mō te hua.
strings.tierB.category.title: Pūmanawa hoko ā-wēna mō ngā kaitohatoha | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Pūmanawa hoko ā-wēna, ā-huarahi: nama ka tāia mai i te waea a te māngai, taonga wēna tētahi ki tētahi, kohinga moni, toronga. Ka mahi tuimotu.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Pūmanawa hoko ā-wēna mō ngā pakihi tohatoha me ngā pakihi hoko rarahi
strings.tierB.category.intro: Ko FieldSales he pūmanawa hoko ā-wēna (van sales) mō ngā kamupene e hoko atu ana ō rātou māngai i runga i tētahi waka i ngā ara o ia rā. Ka uta te māngai i te wēna, ka hoko ki ia toa, ka tā i te nama, ka kohi i te utunga, ka tuhi i ngā whakahokinga, mā te taupānga kotahi i te waea. Ka kite te kaiwhakahaere i ngā mea kua utaina, kua hokona, kua kohia, me ngā mea e toe ana i ia wēna.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: He aha te pūmanawa hoko ā-wēna?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Ko te pūmanawa hoko ā-wēna, e kīia ana hoki he pūmanawa cash van, hoko ā-huarahi rānei, ka whakahaere i tētahi tauira hoko e mauria ai e te māngai ngā taonga i runga i te waka, ā, i te toronga kotahi ka hoko atu, ka kawe, ka tuku nama, ka kohi moni. Ka whakakapi i ngā pukapuka nama pepa me ngā waea i te mutunga o te rā. Ka tuhia ia hoko, ia utunga, ia whakahokinga hei tuhinga, kia taea ai te whakataurite i ngā taonga me te moni i taua rā tonu. Mō te kaiwhakahaere, ka whakautu i ngā pātai e toru ia ahiahi: he aha i hokona atu e ia māngai, he aha i kohia e ia māngai, ā, he aha e toe tonu ana i ia wēna.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: He rā i ngā huarahi
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Ka tīmata te rā ki tētahi utanga kua tuhia mai i te whare putunga ki te wēna. I ia toa ka huaki te māngai i te kōnae o te kiritaki, ka tāpiri hua mā te rārangi, mā te waehere pae (barcode) rānei, ka tuku i te nama, ka tā ki te pūtā wera. Ka tuhia te utunga me tētahi rihīti, ā, ka tuhia ngā whakahokinga me te take. I te mutunga o te rā, ka whakahokia ngā toenga o te wēna ki te whare putunga. I waenga i ēnei, ka whai te kaiwhakahaere i ngā hoko, i ngā kohinga moni me ngā toronga a ia māngai mā te papatohu tukutuku, kāore he waea ki tētahi.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: I hangaia mō te hononga ngoikore
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Ka haere ngā ara tohatoha i ngā papa o raro, i ngā rohe ahumahi me ngā kāinga taiwhenua he ngoikore te hononga. Ka penapena te taupānga a te māngai i ngā kiritaki, i ngā hua me ngā utu ki te waea, kia taea ai e te māngai te tuku me te tā tuhinga me te kore ipurangi. He kī ahurei tō ia tuhinga, nō reira kotahi anake te tukunga ki te tūmau, ahakoa ka whakamātauria anō. Ko ngā kamupene o Hauti Arāpia kua whakahohe i te tūhononga nama hiko, me whai hononga i te wā e tukuna ana ngā nama me ngā whakahokinga. Mō rātou, ka mahi tuimotu tonu ngā rihīti, ngā toronga me ngā kiritaki hou.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Kohinga moni me te kaitiakitanga wēna
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Me pērā anō te tiaki i te moni i ngā huarahi me te tiaki i ngā taonga. Ka whiwhi ia kohinga i tētahi rihīti whai tau, ka taea te hono ki ngā nama e utua ana, ā, ka whakahōu tonu te toenga a te kiritaki. Ka tātaihia ngā taonga o te wēna mō ia hua: ko ngā mea kua utaina, ka tangohia ngā mea kua hokona, ka tāpiria ngā whakahokinga me ngā whakatikatika kua tuhia, kia taea ai e ngā kaiwhakahaere te whakataurite ki tētahi tatau ā-tinana i mua i te hokinga o te māngai ki te kāinga. Ka taea te whakarōpū i ngā whakahokinga hei noa, hei pakaru, hei whakawhitinga rānei, ā, mā te kaiwhakahaere e whakatau mēnā ka hoki ngā taonga kua whakahokia ki ngā taonga o te wēna e taea ana te hoko atu.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Mō wai?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: E hāngai ana a FieldSales ki ngā kaitohatoha me ngā pakihi hoko rarahi o ngā taonga tere-hoko, pērā i te kai, ngā inu, ngā hua horoi me ngā hua tiaki tinana, me ngā kamupene katoa he māngai e toro ana ki ngā toa mā ngā ara. Ka tautoko i te hoko ā-wēna, te tango ota i mua me te tuku tika ki te toa. Ehara i te ERP katoa: ka hono ki tō pūnaha kaute, ERP rānei mā tētahi API. Mā ngā kaiwhakahaere e whakatau ngā mahi e āhei ai ia māngai, pērā i te tuku hekenga utu, te hoko atu i raro i te utu rārangi, te tāpiri kiritaki hou rānei.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: He aha te rerekētanga o te hoko ā-wēna me te tango ota i mua?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: I te hoko ā-wēna, ka mau te māngai i ngā taonga, ā, i te toronga kotahi ka kawe, ka tuku nama, ka kohi moni. I te tango ota i mua, ka tango te māngai i tētahi ota, ā, mā te whare putunga e kawe ā muri. Ka tautoko a FieldSales i ngā mea e rua, nō reira ka taea e tētahi kamupene te whakahaere cash van i ētahi ara, ā, te tango ota i ētahi atu. I ngā tauira e rua, kei te pūnaha kotahi ngā nama, ngā kohinga moni me ngā toenga nama a ngā kiritaki, ā, ka kitea e ngā kaiwhakahaere i ngā pūrongo kotahi.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Me pēhea te whakataurite i tētahi wēna i te mutunga o te rā?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: Ka whakaatu a FieldSales, mō ia hua i ia wēna, i te rahinga kua utaina, kua hokona, kua whakahokia, e toe ana. Whakatauritea te toenga ki tētahi tatau ā-tinana, tuhia ngā rerekētanga hei whakatikatika, kātahi ka whakaheke i ngā toenga ki te whare putunga mā te nekehanga kotahi. Ka tīmata te wēna i te rā e whai ake nei me tētahi toenga mā, e mōhiotia ana.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: He aha ngā taputapu e hiahiatia ana e te māngai hoko ā-wēna?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: He waea atamai, Android, iPhone rānei. Ehara i te mea me whai pūtā wera Bluetooth, engari mā tēnā e taea ai e te māngai te hoatu nama, rihīti kua tāia rānei ki te kiritaki. Kāore a FieldSales e hoko taputapu, kāore hoki e tohe kia whai i tētahi waitohu pūtā. Ka whakamahi ngā kaiwhakahaere i te papatohu tukutuku mai i te pūtirotiro o tētahi rorohiko, waea rānei.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Ka taea e FieldSales te hono ki tō mātou pūnaha kaute?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Āe. He API tā FieldSales e taea ai e tō pūnaha kaute, ERP rānei te whakawhiti kiritaki, hua, nama, rihīti me ngā nekehanga taonga ki te pūhara. Mā tō rōpū, mā tō kaihono pūnaha rānei e hanga te hononga mā ngā tuhinga API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales i ia whenua: moni, tāke, nama hiko
strings.tierB.countries.description: Ka mahi a FieldSales mō ngā kaitohatoha i ia whenua. Tirohia te momo moni, te tāke hoko me te āhua o te nama hiko mō ia whenua i te ripanga kotahi.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: Ka tuku ratonga a FieldSales ki ngā pakihi tohatoha i ia whenua. Ka kōwhiri ia kamupene i tōna whenua, i tōna momo moni me te pāpātanga tāke i ōna tautuhinga, ā, ka whai ngā nama, ngā rihīti me ngā pūrongo i ēnei. Kei Hauti Arāpia anake te tūhononga nama hiko a te kāwanatanga e mahi ana i nāianei. I ērā atu whenua katoa, ka wātea mēnā ka tonoa. Ka whakaatu te ripanga i raro nei, mō ia whenua, te momo moni ā-rohe, te pāpātanga tāke hoko, VAT rānei e whakamahia nuitia ana, me te āhua o te hononga nama hiko a te kāwanatanga: e mahi ana, e wātea ana rānei mēnā ka tonoa.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Ka tautoko mātou i te tūhononga Wāhanga 2 ki te pūhara Fatoora a ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Mā ia kamupene e tautuhi te momo moni me te pāpātanga tāke i ōna ake tautuhinga. He ārahitanga whānui noa ngā pāpātanga o tēnei ripanga, ā, ka huri pea; pātai atu ki tō kaitohutohu tāke hei whakaū i ngā ture o nāianei. Ko te tohu (—) e whakaatu ana kāore he pāpātanga whānui kua rārangitia mō taua whenua.
strings.tierB.about.title: Mō FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: Ka hanga a FieldSales i ngā pūmanawa kapua mō ngā pakihi tohatoha whai māngai hoko haereere. I whakatūria i 2026 i Riyadh, Hauti Arāpia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: He pūhara kapua a FieldSales (ko tōna ingoa Ārapi ko فيلد سيلز) mō ngā pakihi tohatoha me ngā pakihi hoko rarahi e whai māngai hoko haereere ana. I whakatūria te kamupene i 2026, ā, kei Riyadh, Hauti Arāpia tōna tari matua. Ka tuku ratonga ki ngā kamupene o ia whenua, me te momo moni me te pāpātanga tāke o ia whenua e tautuhia ana i ngā tautuhinga a ia kamupene. Ko ā mātou kiritaki ko ngā kamupene e hoko atu ana, e kawe ana mā ngā māngai i ngā huarahi: ngā kaitohatoha, ngā pakihi hoko rarahi me ngā kaihanga whai rōpū hoko ake.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Ka hanga mātou i tētahi pūnaha hono kotahi mō te huringa katoa o te mahi i ngā huarahi: ngā nama ka tāia mai i te waea a te māngai, ngā rihīti me ngā toenga nama a ngā kiritaki, te kaitiakitanga o ngā taonga wēna, ngā ara me ngā toronga me te tauwāhi me ngā whakaahua, me tētahi papatohu tukutuku mō ngā kaiwhakahaere. Ka mahi te taupānga a te māngai i runga Android, iPhone hoki, ka mahi tonu me te kore ipurangi, ā, ka tukutahi ina hoki mai te hononga. Ka taea e ngā kamupene te hono i a FieldSales ki tō rātou pūnaha kaute, ERP rānei mā tētahi API, kia kaua e tuhia anō ngā raraunga o ngā huarahi.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Ka whakaahua mātou i te hua kia rite ki tōna āhua pono. Ka tautoko mātou i te tūhononga Wāhanga 2 ki te pūhara Fatoora a ZATCA. Ka wātea te tūhononga ki ngā pūnaha kāwanatanga o ētahi atu whenua mēnā ka tonoa. Kei ēnei reo te atanga o te taupānga: Ārapi, Ingarihi, Wīwī, Tākei me Hainamana; kāore i te reo Māori. Hei kōrero ki a mātou, tonoa he tātai utu, whakaritea he hui, tukuna mai rānei he karere mā WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Whakapā mai ki FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Kōrero ki te rōpū FieldSales: tonoa he tātai utu, whakaritea he hui, kōrero mai rānei mā WhatsApp mō te pūmanawa māngai hoko me te hoko ā-wēna.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Kōrero mai mō te hoko a ō māngai i nāianei me ngā mea e hiahia ana koe kia huri. Tonoa he tātai utu, whakaritea he hui, tuhi mai rānei mā WhatsApp, ā, ka whakautu mai tētahi o tō mātou rōpū. Mō te tautoko, ka taea e ngā kiritaki o nāianei te whakamahi i aua ara whakapā anō. He āwhina mēnā ka whakahua koe i tō whenua, te maha o ō māngai, ā, mēnā e hoko atu ana rātou i runga i ngā wēna, e tango ota ana, e mahi ana rānei i ngā mea e rua.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Whakaritea he hui ā-ipurangi me tō mātou rōpū. Ka whakaatu mātou i te rā o tētahi māngai i te taupānga me te papatohu a te kaiwhakahaere, me ngā tauira e tata ana ki ō hua me ō ara, ā, ka whakautu i ō pātai mō te whakaritenga.
